subject: [Invite] SF Autumn AI Leaders Dinner, 10/30 @ Spruce
text:
Hi [NAME],

My co-founder, [SENDER], is hosting a dinner in SF for AI leaders later this
month (Thurs 10/30) for ~20 Founders, CTOs and AI Leads working on
interesting and multimodal AI use cases. I saw you're in the Bay Area, so
wanted to personally invite you.

We've booked a private room at Spruce, starting at 6.30pm with good food
and drink, and plenty of time to network (no slides, no set agenda). At our
AI summer dinner in Palo Alto, guests included execs from Agility Robotics,
Rivian, Acubed by Airbus and Thinking Machine Labs, with the conversation
covering AI challenges in unmanned air taxis to multimodal foundation
models for physical AI.

If Encord is new to you, we're a multimodal (video, image, PCD) ML dataops
platform (YC turned Series B scale up). We work with Boston Dynamics,
Figure AI, 1X, Pickle Robot and more in the robotics space to help their AI
and product teams accelerate new model deployment, whilst saving them time
and money across the ML pipeline.

Let me know if you're interested and I'll save you a spot - more than happy
to share full details.

subject: ICCV - ML pipelines that scale for Senior ML/AI Engineer
text:
Hi [NAME],

Will anyone from [COMPANY] be at ICCV this year? Thought there's a good chance
you might be, and I'd love to grab a coffee if so.

Would be great to talk about [COMPANY]'s plans going forward as we find that's
usually around the stage you're at is when teams start reaching out to
Encord to help scale their ML pipelines. This because they find that early,
in-house systems work well to start, but struggle with robustness (e.g.
breaking videos into frames for annotation rather than handling them
natively).

Would be great to hear where [COMPANY] is at and share how we've helped teams
like Flock Safety, LVT, and Milestone Systems unify their data curation,
annotation, and model evaluation through our video-native platform for
father model deployment, whilst saving them time and money across their ML
pipelines.

Let me know if you'll be at ICCV? Happy to grab a quick coffee and trade
notes on the space or feel free to swing by our booth (#605).

subject: Coffee at ICCV'25?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw there's a Computer Vision in Advertising workshop at ICCV this year.
Some AI teams I work on projects with (Zefr & IAS) are taking part. Seems
quite aligned with the ContextIQ paper you co-authored - are you planning
to attend?

A bit of context - I work with CTV teams on improving multimodal training
data quality. We unify auto-annotation with human review across video,
audio and text classification, to make ground-truth labeling more accurate
and human validation more efficient.

Would you be open to exchanger perspectives over a coffee? I'll be at ICCV
Tues (10/21) to Thurs (10/23). Happy to connect virtually also if you
prefer.

subject: Tooling to track small objects on the camera's horizon
text:
Hi [NAME],

I noticed you're developing CV and ML solutions for object detection and
tracking with optical sensors, so thought I'd reach out as our tooling
often helps teams facing challenges you may or may not have encountered yet.

For instance, we recently supported a defence tech team (similar to Fortem)
struggling to track very small objects at the horizon of a camera's view
(sometimes just a few pixels wide). Another common issue we see is
diagnosing model blind spots across terrain or weather conditions and
automating the data collection and annotation loop to address them.

For context, Encord is a multimodal (image, video, radar) ML DataOps
platform that unifies data curation, annotation, and model evaluation to
speed up model iteration. We work with organisations like the Royal Navy,
Anduril, and Skydio.

Would you be open to a quick chat early next week? Happy to share some
short case studies on how we've helped similar teams.
